time_gap_policy: Keep actual timestamps; gaps in this product are at most 3.3 seconds. No inserted frames.
training: Even local indices; odd local indices are held out.
model_selection: One supported slow mode is accepted. Two modes require >5% holdout improvement and >=3 supporting pairs each; otherwise use initial single-slow template when slow mode meets checks.
note: Model selection uses this holdout, so reported improvement is a selection diagnostic rather than untouched test performance.
gap_policy: Enclosed 8-connected missing components <=16 pixels, bounding box <=5x5, valid geometry; harmonic interpolation. Original finite values unchanged. Masks saved per window.
support_policy: At least eight genuine training observations; errors use original observed pixels only.
